<?xml version='1.0' encoding='utf-8'?> <mxfile host="app.diagrams.net"> <diagram name="Class Diagram - ATM (State pattern)" id="atm_class_diagram"> <mxGraphModel dx="1422" dy="762" grid="1" gridSize="10" guides="1" tooltips="1" connect="1" arrows="1" fold="1" page="1" pageScale="1" pageWidth="1290" pageHeight="720" math="0" shadow="0"> <root> <mxCell id="0" /> <mxCell id="1" parent="0" /> <UserObject label="" plantUmlData="{"data": "@startuml
skinparam classAttributeIconSize 0
skinparam monochrome false
skinparam roundcorner 10
skinparam packageStyle rectangle

skinparam class {
 BackgroundColor White
 BorderColor #2C3E50
 ArrowColor #2980B9
}

class ATMControllerApp {
 - atms: List<ATM>
 - activeIdx: Integer
 + runDemonstrationScenario(): void
 + runInteractiveMenu(): void
}

class ATM {
 - id: String
 - totalCash: Integer
 - connectionLossProbability: Double
 - validPin: String
 - currentState: ATMState
 - historyLog: List<String>
 + enterPin(pin: String): OperationResult
 + withdrawCash(amount: Integer): OperationResult
 + finishSession(): OperationResult
 + loadCash(amount: Integer): OperationResult
 + setState(state: ATMState): void
 + getState(): ATMState
 + getStateName(): String
 + checkBankConnection(): Boolean
 + verifyPin(pin: String): Boolean
 + addCash(amount: Integer): void
 + deductCash(amount: Integer): void
 + getId(): String
 + getTotalCash(): Integer
 + getConnectionLossProbability(): Double
}

class OperationResult {
 + success: Boolean
 + message: String
 + previousState: String
 + currentState: String
}

interface ATMState {
 + getName(): String
 + enterPin(atm: ATM, pin: String): OperationResult
 + withdrawCash(atm: ATM, amount: Integer): OperationResult
 + finishSession(atm: ATM): OperationResult
 + loadCash(atm: ATM, amount: Integer): OperationResult
}

class WaitingState {
 + getName(): String
 + enterPin(atm: ATM, pin: String): OperationResult
 + withdrawCash(atm: ATM, amount: Integer): OperationResult
 + finishSession(atm: ATM): OperationResult
 + loadCash(atm: ATM, amount: Integer): OperationResult
}

class AuthenticationState {
 + getName(): String
 + enterPin(atm: ATM, pin: String): OperationResult
 + withdrawCash(atm: ATM, amount: Integer): OperationResult
 + finishSession(atm: ATM): OperationResult
 + loadCash(atm: ATM, amount: Integer): OperationResult
}

class PerformingOperationsState {
 + getName(): String
 + enterPin(atm: ATM, pin: String): OperationResult
 + withdrawCash(atm: ATM, amount: Integer): OperationResult
 + finishSession(atm: ATM): OperationResult
 + loadCash(atm: ATM, amount: Integer): OperationResult
}

class BlockedState {
 + getName(): String
 + enterPin(atm: ATM, pin: String): OperationResult
 + withdrawCash(atm: ATM, amount: Integer): OperationResult
 + finishSession(atm: ATM): OperationResult
 + loadCash(atm: ATM, amount: Integer): OperationResult
}

ATMControllerApp \"1\" *-- \"1..*\" ATM : manages >
ATM \"1\" o-- \"1\" ATMState : currentState >
ATM ..> OperationResult : returns

ATMState <|.. WaitingState
ATMState <|.. AuthenticationState
ATMState <|.. PerformingOperationsState
ATMState <|.. BlockedState

note \"Соответствие шаблону GoF «Состояние» (State):\n• Context → ATM\n• State → ATMState\n• ConcreteState → WaitingState, AuthenticationState,\n PerformingOperationsState, BlockedState\n• Client → ATMControllerApp\" as N1

@enduml
